comment: frozen snapshot of the canonical STOP_HOOK_STEPS from tools/harness.config.mjs. The Stop hook runs the UNION of the local config and this floor: a step present here but missing from the config STILL RUNS, so deleting a turn-fatal check from the config buys nothing. Projects may APPEND steps to the config; they may not subtract. Living under tools/ puts this file inside check-gate-integrity's hashed surface and the write-guard table, which is how the Stop chain became tamper-evident without flipping harness.config.mjs from `config` to `owned`. Regenerate with `node scripts/generate-floor.mjs --write` in the harness repo. SOURCE: docs/harness/README.md (the CI floor).
